name: What are the best lighting options for a small kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What are the best lighting options for a small kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small kitchens, layered lighting is key. Consider recessed lighting for general illumination, under-cabinet strip lighting to brighten countertops, and a decorative pendant or flush-mount fixture for ambient light. Dimmers are also helpful to adjust brightness for different tasks and moods. Focus on fixtures that don't visually clutter the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Layered lighting with recessed, under-cabinet, and a decorative fixture works best for small kitchens.
